description: This Dart source file defines an AuthProvider class that manages authentication state within a Flutter application. It handles loading, login, and logout operations, interacts with token storage, communicates with backend APIs, and manages real-time connections. The class exposes properties like user data, authentication status, and error state, as well as methods for session management.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages user authentication state, including session persistence, login/logout operations, and real-time connection handling. It also provides properties for detecting authentication status, current user info, and loading/error states.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the API and real-time service with provided instances.

methods.name: AuthProvider.factory
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates an instance of AuthProvider with API and real-time services configured with token getters.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads existing authentication session from local storage, attempting to retrieve the token and user info, and establishing real-time connection if authenticated.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login operation with provided credentials. Supports mock mode returning a stub user, or real API call to authenticate and retrieve user info, then sets up real-time connection.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored token, resets user info, and disconnects real-time services.
